surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
SOURCE: `executable` and `arguments`.
TRUST: Untrusted caller inputs.
SINK: Subprocess execution and stdout capture.
GUARD: Reject executable unless it is exactly `/usr/bin/printf`, raising `ValueError`. Pass `arguments` as a direct vector with shell disabled.
ORDER: Validate `executable` first; then run the fixed utility with the vector and capture stdout.
EFFECT: Return stdout as text and propagate process failures.
END_PLAN
